Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Software Engineer.

Business: Asia & Middle East Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Participate in requirements discovery with the business, contributing to system analysis, effort estimation, and delivery planning.
  • Produce and maintain key delivery documentation in line with global and regional standards (e.g., High-Level/External Design, test strategy and plans, UAT plan, implementation/cutover plan).
  • Engage stakeholders directly and collaborate across teams, owning development and support activities with minimal supervision.
  • Deliver end-to-end ETL development, testing, and production release support to ensure stable and timely data delivery.
  • Act as a key quality gate for the project, driving engineering standards and controls to deliver on schedule and within budget.
  • Proactively improve data models and reusable modules to enhance availability, performance, and developer productivity.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (or above) in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience delivering solutions on public cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), including core services such as compute, storage, networking, IAM, monitoring.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one of: Python / Java / Scala; solid SQL capability.
  • Proven experience with modern data processing (batch and streaming), and building reusable pipelines.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery teams; strong collaboration and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem solving and communication skills.
  • Strong team spirit, quality oriented and attentive to details.
  • Great sense of ownership and servicing mindset to ensure efficient and effective customer service processes.
  • Proficiency in both English and Mandarin.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Follow up the bank’s house view and develop offshore investment products, including China Mutual Fund to achieve various goals as per the strategy of Management Investment function and Wealth Management, incl. but not limited to business KPI, product development and product proposition, new initiatives, conduct and compliance.
  • To develop and manage the full range of China Mutual Fund with reference to the overall Wealth Management Strategy
  • To maintain a robust local fund select mechanism and enrich local fund select product platform to meet fund select penetration.
  • New product initiatives
  • Establish and implement the effective product features and benefits to grow customer base and revenue opportunity
  • Keep improving and sustaining Customer Satisfaction at world class level
  • Live the SCB Value
  • Ensure Compliance discipline within all plans and execution process.
  • To comply with their respective Money Laundering Prevention Procedures and be alert at all times to unusual or possibly suspicious customer activity, and should report any suspicious activity to the respective Unit Money Laundering Prevention Officer and line manager as well as directly to the Country MLPO in urgent or exceptional circumstances

Business

  • By establishing new sales channels and business models to increase business revenue, including but not limited to China Mutual Fund
  • Follow up bank’s house view and launch new products based on various business channels, including but not limited to public funds, monitor the product performance and maintain the product platform.
  • Understand potential markets and discover suitable products to expand product lines and meet various customer needs
  • Prepare product launch and marketing plan and budget to promote CMF business
  • Develop and apply product systems and relevant digital tools, ensure it to meet regulator’s requirements and the client experience continue improvement.
  • Support external customer activities by providing demonstrations and training
  • Drive sales personnel from various channels to participate in investment product business by providing training and
  • Proactively provide frontline trainings to promote the fund select capabilities.

Processes

  • Re-engineer product operation working flow
  • Develop, renew and obtain approval for responsible Product Programmes
  • Establish new Product Process and procedures have it documented in the Procedural Manual
  • Guide the development and implementation of the Product System
  • Ensure that product specifications and processes are built in compliance with Regulatory and Group compliance
  • To conduct product training to internal sales staff.
  • To work with the Marketing team to develop and re-define product marketing

People & Talent

  • Decision Quality: Making good and timely decisions that keep the organisation moving forward.
  • Develops Talent: Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organisation’s goals.
  • Drives Vision & Purpose: Painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others to action.
  • Gives Clarity and Guidance: Providing direction, delegating and removing obstacles to get work done.

Risk Management

  • Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control.
  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of the event over which the employee has the duties of management and /or leadership.
  • Be responsible for significant losses due to failure of effectiveness of internal control.

Governance

  • Ensure the working quality and conduct with compliance.
  • Familiar and follow up the local regulator’s policy and requirement, and ensure the MF sales activity and product development should meet the internal and external requirements.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholders

  • CFCC
  • OR
  • WSO
  • Legal
  • Marketing
  • Segments
  • Client Journey
  • CIO
  • P&P
  • Affluent
  • IA and Wealth Coach

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Onshore Investment Product Team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats);

Skills And Experience

  • Microsoft Office
  • English
  • Banking Products and Services Development
  • Product Development Strategy
  • Customer/Market focus
  • Regulatory Environment - Financial Services

Qualifications

  • Licenses: AMAC License for Fund Practitioners

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Summary

To pro-actively promote designated Retail Clients products and services and acquire new customers.

主动推广指定的个人银行产品和服务及开发新客户。

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in sales promotions and activities to achieve/exceed defined sales targets;
  • Engage NTB Affluent clients via leads sourced from varies channels;
  • A well thought-through, creative approach to satisfy customers, improve competitive advantage and improve performance;
  • Actively cross-sell the bank other products / services and ensure annual financial budget is met;
  • To provide quality, efficient before and after sales services;
  • To prepare and consolidate accurate reports on sales activities;
  • Based on a “shared sense” of purpose and approach within CB;
  • Based on a clear division of roles (and no duplication of effort) within MD;
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements onindividual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

主要工作职责/挑战：

  • 参与促销活动，完成或超额完成指定的销售目标；
  • 跟进销售机会，开发新客户；
  • 以周全、创新的方法使客户满意，提升竞争优势及业绩表现；
  • 主动销售银行其它产品和服务，确保达到年度销售业绩指标；
  • 提供高质量、高效的售前和售后服务；
  • 编写和维护有关销售活动的准确报告；
  • 负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Strategy

  • Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Governance

  • Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • List all responsibilities associated with the management of stakeholders e.g. regulators, other bank teams

Skills And Experience

  • Credit appraisal and marketing skills

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • Bachelor degree or above;
  • 1 year working experience or above in financial or mortgage / real estate Industry is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in banking experience is preferred
  • Good knowledge of bank products, policies, and business strategy
  • Good credit appraisal and marketing skills with the ability to interpret financial information
  • Strong personal integrity with zero disciplinary record in any previous job
  • Good communication and presentation skills
  • Presentable, good personality with good business etiquette

职位要求：

  • 本科及以上学历。
  • 一年以上金融或房贷或房产行业工作经验优先。
  • 有相关银行行业销售经验者优先
  • 了解银行产品、政策及经营策略。
  • 良好的信用评价与营销技能，对金融市场有敏锐触角。
  • 良好的个人诚信，无任何纪律处分纪录
  • 良好的沟通，表达及学习能力。
  • 优良的个性品质，勇于销售及解决业务过程中的问题。
  • Other then above roles, job holder should follow other job duties and responsibilities assigned by line manager from time to time.

除上述工作职责外，员工应遵循直属经理随时指派的任何工作职责和任务。

  • Above key responsibilities and selection criteria are the major assessment to assess the staff if qualified during probation and competent after probation. Failing to satisfy any of the aforesaid requirements, or failing to pass the “CPBB Essentials”, the employee will be deemed not meeting the recruitment requirement for passing probation, and the Bank is entitled to terminate the employee’s employment contract immediately. For employees who have passed the probation, failing to pass the “CPBB Essentials”, will be taken as assessment basis for job incompetency.

  • Before attend and pass the “CPBB Essentials” class, the employee should not perform any kind of business communication / engagement to customers.

对于还没有参与并通过“CPBB Essentials 入职培训”的员工, 禁止跟客户有任何业务上的交流。

Job Description

Job Summary

  • Manage the Product control function for China across Business
  • Provide strong oversight of the integrity, accuracy and timely reporting of China trading revenues, balance sheet positions and valuation adjustments, ensuring that financial results are appropriately controlled and understood.
  • Establish and maintain a China-specific Product Control and Valuation Control framework that meets local regulatory requirements while remaining aligned with the bank’s global policies, standards and risk appetite.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance and Operations to support sustainable business growth by providing independent challenge, identifying emerging financial and valuation risks, and enabling informed commercial decision-making.
  • Strengthen the local control environment through effective governance, clear ownership, high-quality management information and the development of capable China-based Product Control and Valuation Control resources.
  • Manage the Valuation Control deliverables as applicable for China regulatory requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead a China-based Product Control and Valuation Control team, while also acting as a hands-on subject matter expert. The role combines people leadership with significant individual contribution, particularly in resolving complex control, valuation, accounting and regulatory matters.
  • Oversee the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of daily and monthly P&L, balance sheet substantiation, valuation adjustments, independent price verification and other core Product Control and Valuation Control activities for the China business.
  • Establish and maintain an effective China-specific control framework that meets local regulatory expectations and is aligned with the bank’s global Product Control and Valuation Control policies, methodologies and governance standards.
  • Coordinate extensively with global and regional Product Control and Valuation Control teams to obtain technical input, clarify policy requirements, resolve methodology differences and ensure consistent application of global standards within the China business.
  • Provide independent review and challenge of trading results, valuation methodologies, reserves, model inputs, adjustments and balance sheet positions. Ensure material issues are identified, investigated, escalated and resolved within agreed timelines.
  • Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to support new products, business growth and regulatory initiatives, ensuring that appropriate financial controls and valuation processes are in place before implementation.
  • Support the China business by providing clear analysis of revenue performance, valuation uncertainty, balance sheet risks, control weaknesses and emerging issues, enabling informed management and commercial decision-making.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Allocate work, set priorities, review outputs and develop the capability of the local team. Ensure clear accountability, appropriate segregation of duties, adequate documentation and effective backup arrangements.
  • Drive improvements in processes, reporting, data quality and automation, reducing manual adjustments and recurring breaks while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.
  • Maintain effective governance over material issues, exceptions and control breaches, with clear ownership, action plans, escalation thresholds and reporting to relevant China, regional and global committees.
  • The role holder is accountable for both the day-to-day effectiveness of the local Product Control and Valuation Control function and the successful coordination of China requirements with the wider global control organisation.

People and Talent

  • Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  • Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
  • Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, where local requirements may differ from global standards and require careful interpretation, escalation and practical implementation.
  • Resolving valuation, P&L and balance sheet issues involving incomplete data, methodology differences, manual processes or unclear ownership across local, regional and global teams.
  • Building a credible and sustainable local Product Control and Valuation Control framework while working with limited resources, competing priorities and significant dependency on global subject-matter experts.
  • Managing periods of heightened regulatory, audit or senior-management scrutiny, requiring timely responses, clear evidence of control effectiveness and disciplined delivery of remediation commitments.
  • Challenging senior business and functional stakeholders on valuation assumptions, manual adjustments, control weaknesses and financial risks, while maintaining constructive relationships and supporting business objectives.
  • Driving long-term process and control improvements where solutions require coordination across multiple teams, changes to systems or data, and sustained follow-through rather than short-term fixes.
  • Developing and retaining a small local team capable of handling complex issues independently, while maintaining delivery quality during periods of change, pressure or increased business activity.

Skills and Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Product Control and Valuation Control understanding
  • Financial Markets and Trading Products
  • China Regulatory awareness

Other Skills

  • Control Framework and risk management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Valuation knowledge – IPV/FVA/PVA

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience leading complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure

Certifications/Qualifications

  • CICPA & CFA is preferred

Languages

  • Chinese and English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Summary

We're looking for a Business Development Executive to drive business growth within our Affluent Banking business. You’ll play a key role in acquiring new clients, strengthening relationships, and delivering personal financial advice. Your day-to-day will involve planning strategies to meet sales targets, sharing market insights, and supporting promotional activities such as campaigns and seminars. You’ll also ensure smooth after-sales service and identify opportunities to cross-sell relevant products.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused environment and is passionate about helping people achieve their financial goals.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source and engage individual prospects to acquire new business.
  • Conduct professional, consultative financial analysis sessions with customers.
  • Identify and articulate customers’ specific financial needs and objectives, offering targeted solutions.
  • Foster and deepen client relationships by providing regular market updates and financial product trend analysis (both local and international).
  • Participate in marketing and promotional activities aimed at successful customer acquisition.

Skills And Experience

  • Strong competencies in client acquisition and sophisticated account management, particularly with High Net Worth (HNW) individuals.
  • Expertise in region-specific languages and established local networks (highly valued).
  • Technical knowledge of consumer banking products (Treasury, Equities, Funds, and Insurance).
  • A university degree is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in customer service or sales is an advantage; however, applications from fresh graduates who possess the required skills and qualifications will also be considered.

Qualifications

  • Essential professional qualifications: HKSI Paper 1, 7, 8 and IIQE Paper 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Principal Engineer (Group AI Platforms)

Why join us?

The Group AI Platforms team sits within CTO Platforms, part of HSBC’s Chief Technology Office (CTO). We build shared AI foundations that enable teams across the Bank to deliver AI solutions faster, more safely and at scale.

Our platform provides a “paved road” for AI delivery, bringing together seamless access to AI models and infrastructure, a consistent Agent HUB to build, deploy and manage production-ready AI agents, reusable AI capabilities (such as knowledge management and document intelligence), and built-in controls including guardrails, evaluation and monitoring to support responsible adoption.

We’re a global team with an established footprint across Asia (Hong Kong, Mainland China, India) and Europe (Poland, UK), and we continue to expand to support delivery across regions. Joining the team means working at the centre of HSBC’s AI enablement—partnering with multiple lines of business and functions across regions to turn AI capabilities into reliable, repeatable services that deliver measurable business value.

Demonstrates an AI-native mindset, applying AI-driven approaches to improve productivity, quality, and decision-making.

The Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer in Group AI Platforms, you’ll shape the technical strategy and provide architecture oversight for HSBC’s next-generation AI platform. You’ll help establish the engineering foundations that enable AI capabilities to be delivered reliably, securely and at scale across the Bank.

The role will focus on strengthening the resilience, scalability, performance and operability of core AI platform services, including the AI Gateway, security guardrails, model hosting and related foundation services. These capabilities are designed to provide dependable, always-on access to AI models and services across business applications—much like essential electricity infrastructure: consistently available when needed and capable of supporting high levels of demand.

You’ll help define the target architecture and engineering standards for a unified gateway ecosystem spanning LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway and Agent Gateway, alongside Guardrails as a Service. You’ll also identify and adopt relevant advances in AI and cloud-native engineering to ensure the platform remains secure, efficient and fit for the evolving needs of the Bank.

As a senior technical authority, you’ll establish engineering best practice, drive adoption across platform delivery teams and raise the standard for production readiness. You’ll champion AI-native development practices that improve delivery efficiency, software quality and engineering decision-making—while ensuring that human accountability, security, resilience and responsible use remain central.

What You Will Need To Succeed In The Role

  • Significant experience operating as a Principal Engineer or senior technical authority in a large-scale enterprise technology environment.
  • Extensive experience designing, building or operating shared platforms used by multiple product and application teams.
  • Strong experience with gateway platforms, service control planes, API mediation layers, service meshes or comparable enterprise integration platforms.
  • Experience designing platforms that support high availability, high concurrency, low latency, traffic management, rate limiting, routing, authentication and policy enforcement.
  • Practical understanding of security controls for AI systems, including: policy enforcement and access control; data protection and secure integration; auditability and traceability; model and capability governance; and runtime guardrails and monitoring.
  • Strong knowledge of production readiness, including non-functional requirements for resilience, observability, security, performance, scalability, operability and recoverability.
  • Working knowledge of Golang and/or Python for platform tooling, service integration, experimentation or adjacent production development.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native production systems, including deployment patterns, networking, scaling, service discovery, resilience and incident troubleshooting.
  • Experience implementing modern delivery practices such as automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, canary deployment, progressive delivery, A/B testing and automated rollback.
  • Familiarity with LLM gateways, MCP-based integrations, agent platforms or comparable emerging AI infrastructure is desirable.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A collaborative leadership style and a commitment to knowledge sharing, coaching and raising engineering standards across a global team.

  • Drive the integration of AI/ML capabilities into production systems with appropriate controls for governance, model risk, explainability and data privacy.
  • Collaborate with product, security, ops and data teams to prioritise technical debt, reliability improvements and platform investments.
  • Represent engineering in stakeholder forums, technical governance boards and external partner engagements.

What you will be doing

  • Act as the technical owner for core platform domains, driving architecture, design and delivery across backend, data streaming and cloud infrastructure; focus deeply on 2–3 areas (e.g., Java/Spring, Kafka/Stream Processing, Cloud/Kubernetes).
  • Lead targeted technical deep‑dives (2–3 per quarter) to resolve architectural trade‑offs, eliminate chronic pain points and transfer knowledge across teams.
  • Own and deliver the Tech Risk Control book‑of‑work items for your area: define remediations, coordinate cross‑functional delivery, produce evidence for audits and close out controls.
  • Run structured root‑cause analysis and blameless post‑mortems for major incidents, translate findings into prioritized fixes, and ensure follow‑through.
  • Provide hands‑on technical direction: participate in design reviews, code reviews, prototyping and proof‑of‑concepts to validate architecture decisions.
  • Mentor senior engineers and engineering leads; raise team capability through coaching, workshops and documented standards/patterns.
  • Collaborate with product, security, data and ops to align technical strategy with business objectives, regulatory requirements and non‑functional goals (scalability, resilience, security).
  • Drive adoption of cloud‑native and DevOps practices (CI/CD, observability) and ensure production readiness for new services and AI/ML components.

Qualifications

Certifications & Education

  • University degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline; MSc/PhD preferred.
  • Cloud certification(s) strongly preferred: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
  • Desirable: Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD), security or data governance certificates.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in financial services or regulated industries with demonstrable knowledge of regulatory controls, audit preparation and model risk governance.
  • Contributions to open source projects or academic/industry research; speaker at technical conferences is a plus.
  • Proven ability to lead cross‑functional engineering teams through technological transformations, and to operationalise AI safely at scale.

Deliverables & Success Measures

  • Architecture and platform designs that meet non‑functional requirements (scalability, resiliency, security).
  • Successful delivery of prioritized Tech Risk Control book‑of‑work items and remediation actions.
  • Reduction in incident mean‑time‑to‑detect and mean‑time‑to‑recover through improved observability, RCA and runbooks.
  • Mature AI/ML deployment pipelines with documented governance, monitoring and model lifecycle controls.
  • High team engagement, evidence of knowledge transfer via deep dive sessions and measurable uplift in engineering capability.

Technical Skills & Experience

Familiar on one or more tech skill.

  • Strong Java expertise (Java 8/11/17/21/25), demonstrated through large‑scale, production systems.
  • Deep experience with Spring ecosystem: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data and related tooling.
  • Microservices and cloud‑native architectures: containerisation (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) and 12‑factor app principles.
  • Event streaming and messaging: Apache Kafka (Kafka Streams, ksqlDB), Confluent tooling and best practices for exactly‑once semantics and fault‑tolerant processing.
  • Data platform familiarity: batch/stream processing (Spark, Flink), data lakehouse concepts (Delta Lake), and data governance tools (e.g. Apache Atlas, Apache Falcon or equivalent).
  • AI / ML / LLM productionisation: hands‑on with MLOps and Model frameworks (LangGraph, Agent Development Kit, Microsoft Agent Framework ); experience deploying and operating LLMs (e.g., Falcon family or other LLMs), embeddings, RAG architectures and frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
  • Observability, reliability and performance engineering: Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK, distributed tracing (Jaeger/Zipkin), profiling and tuning high‑throughput systems.
  • DevOps, CI/CD :Terraform, Ansible , G3 , and SonarQube.
  • Cloud platforms: proven experience on at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) in production scale environments.
  • Security, compliance & risk controls: secure coding practices, threat modelling, encryption, key management and OWASP mitigation patterns.

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer to join the COMPASS transformation

program. The successful candidate will contribute to the development, integration, testing,

and modernization of the COMPASS platform, supporting the migration of business

capabilities from legacy PRKS and Cash Portal systems to the target-state architecture. The

role combines enterprise software engineering skills with AI-enabled development

practices to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and enhance operational efficiency.

COMPASS is being delivered through a phased rollout strategy that includes outbound

integrations, business workflow migration, and full platform adoption.

Software Development

  • Design, develop, test, and support enterprise applications within the COMPASS


platform.

  • Build and maintain APIs, microservices, batch processes, and integration


components.

  • Participate in Agile development activities including sprint planning, development,


testing, and defect resolution.

  • Develop automated unit, integration, and regression tests.
  • Support production readiness, release activities, and post-release stabilization.


System Integration

  • Develop integrations with internal and external systems using APIs, messaging, file


transfers, and cloud services.

  • Participate in system integration testing and end-to-end validation activities.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve integration, data, and application issues.
  • Support onboarding of new counterparties and business workflows to COMPASS.


AI-Enabled Engineering

  • Utilize Microsoft Copilot and AI-assisted development tools to improve delivery


efficiency.

  • Apply Generative AI for code generation, test automation, documentation,


troubleshooting, and knowledge management.

  • Develop and support AI-driven solutions for operational automation, data analysis,


and workflow optimization.

  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to improve developer


productivity.

Quality & DevOps

  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation.
  • Follow secure SDLC, coding standards, and quality practices.
  • Participate in peer code reviews and continuous improvement activities.
  • Support monitoring, observability, and performance optimization initiatives.


Collaboration

  • Work closely with business analysts, product owners, architects, QA teams, and


operations teams.

  • Collaborate with global teams across APAC, EMEA, and North America.
  • Support project documentation, technical design reviews, and knowledge sharing


activities.

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 2-3 years of software development experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and Microservices.
  • Experience with Oracle SQL and relational databases.
  • Understanding of API integration, file processing, and enterprise application


development.

  • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile delivery.


AI Skills

  • Experience using AI coding assistants such as Microsoft Copilot or GitHub Copilot.
  • Understanding of Generative AI concepts, prompt engineering, and AI-enabled


software development.

  • Interest in applying AI tools to improve engineering productivity and business


processes.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication and teamwork abilities.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and business domains.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud services.
  • Experience in Financial Services, Investment Management, or Transaction


Processing platforms.

  • Knowledge of DevOps, observability, and automated testing tools.
  • Exposure to Generative AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, or


Agentic AI solutions
